name: M4 socket-head cap screw (DIN 912 envelope)
summary: Thread-free M4 socket-head cap screw envelope: 7 mm head dia x 4 mm high, 4 mm shank, 3 mm hex socket. Origin on the head bearing face, shank along -Z.
preview: M4 SHCS envelope, head 7x4 mm, shank 4 mm, length 6-40 mm (default 16)

length.doc: shank length below the head, mm

origin: head bearing face; head spans 0..+k in Z, shank runs -Z
simplifications: no under-head fillet or washer face
hex socket is a straight prism, not a broached form
